texts.zh:
[From.Planet.GetName]上遗弃设施的入口建设得格外地坚固。显然非常地耐用，外表铺着有厚重的装甲、辐射护盾和一座气象传感阵列。[Leader.GetName]相信它是用来抵御极端条件的。

扫描表明，通过数道密封的安全门之后可以抵达一座巨大的地下舱室。
texts.en:
The entrance of the isolated complex on [From.Planet.GetName] is of exceptionally robust construction. Clearly built to last, its exterior features heavy armor plating, radiation shields, and an array of atmospheric sensors. [Leader.GetName] believes it was built to withstand extreme conditions.

Scans suggest that a large underground chamber can be accessed via a series of sealed security doors.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the planet's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

texts.zh:
在进入主要舱室后，[Leader.GetName]得出结论，我们发现了一座很久以前为某些未知有机物种建造的尚未启用的生存避难所。

它配备了储备充足的居住区，包括睡眠舱、休闲区和医疗舱。每层楼的储物柜里都有大量未开封的营养包、电池和工具。这座隐藏的洞穴里的所有东西都处于未使用的状态。

最后一扇安全门仍然密封这着，我们相信打开它便会到达基地的指挥室。
texts.en:
Having gained access to the main interior, [Leader.GetName] concludes that we have discovered an unused survival shelter, built long ago for some unknown organic species.

It is outfitted with well stocked habitation quarters comprising sleep pods, leisure zones, and a medical bay. Storage lockers on every floor hold deep reserves of unopened nutrient packs, batteries, and tools. Everything contained in this hidden vault is in pristine condition.

One final set of security doors remains sealed. We believe they will lead us to the facility's command deck.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这位人物的名字。
note.en: In the game, the character's name appears here.

texts.zh:
这座舱室的指挥面板上有一组令人印象深刻的宇宙风暴显示器，全部连接着外面的气象探测阵列。这些控制台在待机状态运行后，储存了了几个世纪以来的历史风暴数据，这将极大地促进我们对星际气象学的理解。

[Leader.GetName]还找到了一台精致小巧的全息投影仪。当被激活时，它会投射出一个3D的软体类模型，从带着公司标志的庇护所地标边跑过，一边进行着推销。

这个幸存的产品是否找到了买家不得而知，但它显然已经在这里闲置了很多年。
texts.en:
The shelter's command deck is equipped with an impressive array of Cosmic Storm monitors, all fed by the atmospheric sensors on the surface. After running on standby, these consoles contain centuries' worth of historical storm data, which will greatly advance our understanding of astrometeorology.

[Leader.GetName] also found a small and well-used holo-projector. When activated, it beams a 3D molluscoid figure delivering a sales pitch, running through the shelter's key features under a corporate logo.

Whether this survival product ever found a buyer is impossible to say, but it has clearly remained unused here for many years.

texts.zh: 我们的营销部门已经在分析哪里出了问题。
texts.en: Our marketing departments are already analyzing where they went wrong.

summary.text:
# 设施复工 / Repowered Complex

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · DLC：Cosmic Storms

## 如何开始 How it starts

电磁风暴离开星系时（on_storm_left_system，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5440 直接列出 cstorms.1840），隐藏事件 cstorms.1840（cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4659-4704）要求风暴为 electric_storm，且系统中有一颗没有风暴影响标记、没有遗址、没有异常、非人造的行星；随后50%几率（random_list 1/1）在其中一颗上创建 site_repowered_complex，并设置 afflicted_by_storm_event。

When an electric storm leaves a system (on_storm_left_system lists cstorms.1840 directly, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:5440), hidden cstorms.1840 (cosmic_storms_events_1.txt:4659-4704) requires an electric_storm and a natural planet in the system with no storm-affliction flag, site or anomaly; it then has a 50% chance (random_list 1/1) to create site_repowered_complex on one such planet and sets afflicted_by_storm_event.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

三个阶段（难度2、3、4，需要科学家领袖，失败时无随机事件 no_events，10_cosmic_storms_arc_sites.txt:687-725）：1845 加固入口（小型神器奖励与团结月度加成）→ 1850 生存庇护所（食物/能量/消费品/矿物月度加成）→ 1855 豪华庇护所套装（风暴监测设备；巨型企业有单独文字）。

Three stages (difficulty 2, 3, 4, scientist leader, no random events on failure, 10_cosmic_storms_arc_sites.txt:687-725): 1845 Fortified Entrance (small artifact reward and a unity bonus) -> 1850 Survival Shelter (monthly food/energy/consumer goods/minerals) -> 1855 The Deluxe Shelter Package (storm monitors; megacorporations get their own text).

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

线性、无分支。

Linear, no branches.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

1855 对巨型企业使用不同正文。

1855 uses different body text for megacorporations.
